item.title: Candace Owens drops explosive claim on Charlie Kirk's assassination with shocking twist about Tyler Robinson fingerprints
item.description: Candace Owens questions the official narrative surrounding Charlie Kirk's shooting, suggesting a planned setup involving multiple individuals. She claims Tyler Robinson's role was limited, with his fingerprints not being the only ones on the weapon. Owens also alleges Lance Twiggs played a more significant, albeit different, part in the incident, citing a TMZ video as evidence.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is Tom Steyer? Billionaire climate crusader announces run for California governor
item.description: Billionaire activist Tom Steyer has launched his bid for California governor, aiming to address the state's affordability crisis. Having previously run for president, Steyer, a significant Democratic donor, pledges to lower utility bills, build homes, and make education free. He enters a crowded Democratic field facing Republican challenges, with former frontrunner Katie Porter recently facing scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who is Jessica Tisch? NYPD commissioner with anti-crime focus working amid Mamdani’s police reform plans
item.description: In a bold move ahead of his January inauguration, Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani has confirmed Jessica Tisch as NYPD Commissioner. This choice, while reflecting their divergent views on policing, underscores a shared commitment to enhancing public safety and reducing crime.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Asmongold defends xQc’s ‘just chatting’ nomination as Hasan calls out awards snub
item.description: Controversy surrounds the Streamer Awards "just chatting" nominations. XQc secured a spot while Hasan was excluded, sparking debate. Asmongold explained that award decisions consider broader factors beyond content volume. This highlights the ongoing tension between community expectations and the criteria used by award institutions. The debate questions the merit of awards when market positioning plays a role.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: ‘Trump dislikes Muslims, except billionaires’: Bernie Sanders attacks US President over Saudi Crown Prince meeting
item.description: In a display of opulence, US President Donald Trump welcomed Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, prompting backlash from Senator Bernie Sanders. Although US intelligence linked the Prince to Jamal Khashoggi's murder, Trump lauded his accomplishments as 'extraordinary.' The visit featured important discussions on defense strategies and lucrative commercial partnerships.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: New York gridlock alert: These are the dates when traffic will be at its worst in 2025
item.description: New York City has announced 2025 Gridlock Alert Days, pinpointing peak traffic congestion periods. These dates, coinciding with major events and holiday travel, urge residents to opt for public transport, cycling, or walking. The DOT is promoting greener travel, highlighting new bike infrastructure like the First Avenue Tunnel protected lane to ease citywide delays.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Fact Check: Did Donald Trump make post about Fortnite Friday Streamer Awards 2025? The truth behind viral claim
item.description: Viral online claims that Donald Trump denounced the Fortnite Friday Streamer Awards nomination as 'socialist propaganda' are false. A doctored screenshot circulated widely, but no such post exists on Trump's Truth Social. The show, hosted by ConnorEatsPants, is nominated for 'Best Streamed Series' at the 2025 awards, a nomination determined by fan votes.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: N3on gets flagged for lying about liking Black people in wild moment with Adin Ross and Tekashi 6ix9ine
item.description: During a YouTube lie detector test, streamer N3on's response to liking Black people registered as false, causing shock and laughter among Adin Ross, Tekashi 6ix9ine, Antonio Brown, and BenDaDonnn. The unexpected result, especially with Antonio Brown's recent legal issues present, quickly went viral, sparking widespread reactions and discussions across social media platforms.

item.title: Who is Ro Khanna? Indian-origin Democrat in spotlight after leading landslide vote to release Epstein files
item.description: Congress has voted to release Justice Department files on Jeffrey Epstein. This move has brought Rep. Ro Khanna into the spotlight. He believes this success validates his bipartisan approach. Khanna is now considering a presidential run in 2028. His background includes being a Silicon Valley representative and author. He is of Indian origin and married with two children. Read below!

item.title: Donald Trump's son weighs in on release of Jeffrey Epstein files: 'It’s clear from all emails that...'
item.description: In a striking revelation, Donald Trump Jr. has pointed to freshly unearthed emails indicating that Jeffrey Epstein harbored a disdain for his father, implying that Epstein may have been poised to exploit any damaging secrets. This comes in light of Congress's recent overwhelming approval of a bill aimed at releasing documents related to Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: White House posts Trump and Ronaldo’s GOAT moment: What the caption ‘CR7 × 45/47’ really means
item.description: President Trump and football legend Cristiano Ronaldo were captured in a viral White House video captioned "Two GOATs." This clip, shared during Ronaldo's attendance at a state dinner, merged Ronaldo's iconic "CR7" brand with Trump's "45/47" political shorthand, sparking widespread online discussion and speculation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Watch: Trump says Barron ‘is a big fan of Ronaldo’ as football star attends White House dinner
item.description: During a lavish state dinner, President Trump shared a heartfelt moment involving his son Barron, who had the chance to meet legendary football player Cristiano Ronaldo. Trump expressed that this encounter has boosted Barron's admiration for him.

item.title: Candace Owens brings attention to YouTuber claim of TPUSA financial delay before Charlie Kirk shooting
item.description: Candace Owens is raising serious questions about Turning Point USA's finances and leadership following Charlie Kirk's death. Owens highlighted claims of delayed financial filings and a significant sum transferred to a shell group shortly before Kirk was fatally shot. She expressed concern over TPUSA's response and suggested Kirk may have uncovered financial irregularities.

item.title: ‘Islamist terrorism is the greatest threat to United States’: DNI Tulsi Gabbard warns of ‘rising extremism’
item.description: US Intelligence Director Tulsi Gabbard warns that Islamist terrorism, now characterized by online-radicalized lone wolves rather than organized groups, poses the most serious threat. Her approach, shaped by 9/11 and military service, emphasizes confronting ideological dangers. Gabbard advocates for agency reforms to better address this evolving, diffuse threat landscape.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 3I/ATLAS: Elon Musk vows to reveal any alien evidence on Joe Rogan’s show; warns it could flatten a continent
item.description: Elon Musk has weighed in on 3I/ATLAS, the enormous interstellar object stirring both scientific scrutiny and alien speculation. Speaking on The Joe Rogan Experience, he warned it could obliterate a continent, and promised to reveal any alien evidence on-air if he ever had it. With researchers split between natural explanations and ominous unknowns, the object’s December reappearance is generating intense anticipation.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk
